title: Agenda Voting
description: How a player votes during the agenda phase: the agenda card with both outcomes, spending influence on planets, and the speaker's tie-break.

shots.heading: Casting a vote
shots.caption: The modal names the agenda (Sling Relay) and spells out what FOR and AGAINST do, so nobody has to remember the card. Each outcome shows the votes already cast; Abstain is always offered.

shots.heading: Spending influence
shots.caption: Planets are staged into a basket before anything is exhausted. Mecatol Rex (6) and Jord (2) are staged for +8 votes; Lodor (3) is still available. Reset clears the basket, Cast votes sends it.

shots.heading: Breaking a tie
shots.caption: When the tally is level the speaker chooses the outcome, with the same agenda card in view.

notes.title: Round state
notes.text: The top bar keeps the round, the phase and the speaker visible while the vote is open.

notes.title: Known rough edge
notes.text: The orange turn banner still prints the raw decision name, for example cast_vote.
